sn45.8:1.2: See note on [sn12.2:1.2]() for a discussion of “analysis” discourses.
sn45.8:3.1: A “view” (_diṭṭhi_) is the theory or set of beliefs through which one makes sense of the world. By itself it is neutral, although “views” in plural sometimes stands for the thicket of wrong views.
sn45.8:4.1: _Saṅkappa_ may be rendered with “thought” ([sn14.8:3.3](), [mn60:24.2]()), “intention” ([mn41:14.3]()), or perhaps “resolve”.
